package vparquet4

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/jsonpb"
	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb"
	cv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/common/v1"
	rv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/resource/v1"
	tv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/trace/v1"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/traceql"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/backend"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/encoding/common"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"testing"
)

func value(key, v string) *cv.KeyValue {
	return &cv.KeyValue{Key: key, Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_StringValue{StringValue: v}}}
}
func batch(id int, service, name string, span, parent byte, start, end uint64) *tv.ResourceSpans {
	tid := make([]byte, 16)
	tid[15] = byte(id)
	sid := make([]byte, 8)
	sid[7] = span
	var pid []byte
	if parent != 0 {
		pid = make([]byte, 8)
		pid[7] = parent
	}
	return &tv.ResourceSpans{Resource: &rv.Resource{Attributes: []*cv.KeyValue{value("service.namespace", "example"), value("service.name", service), value("deployment.environment", "production")}}, ScopeSpans: []*tv.ScopeSpans{{Spans: []*tv.Span{{TraceId: tid, SpanId: sid, ParentSpanId: pid, Name: name, StartTimeUnixNano: start, EndTimeUnixNano: end}}}}}
}
func TestPulseOracle(t *testing.T) {
	ns := uint64(1_000_000_000)
	inputs := []*tempopb.Trace{
		{ResourceSpans: []*tv.ResourceSpans{batch(1, "frontend", "request", 1, 0, 10*ns, 50*ns), batch(1, "worker", "outside-window", 2, 1, 45*ns, 46*ns)}},
		{ResourceSpans: []*tv.ResourceSpans{batch(2, "worker", "before", 1, 0, 20*ns, 24*ns)}},
		{ResourceSpans: []*tv.ResourceSpans{batch(3, "frontend", "newer", 1, 0, 35*ns, 36*ns), batch(3, "worker", "inside", 2, 1, 37*ns, 38*ns)}},
		{ResourceSpans: []*tv.ResourceSpans{batch(4, "worker", "after", 1, 0, 41*ns, 45*ns)}},
		{ResourceSpans: []*tv.ResourceSpans{batch(5, "worker", "missing-root", 2, 1, 32*ns, 47*ns)}},
		{ResourceSpans: []*tv.ResourceSpans{batch(6, "frontend", "gap-root", 1, 0, 10*ns, 15*ns), batch(6, "worker", "gap-match", 2, 1, 70*ns, 71*ns)}},
		{ResourceSpans: []*tv.ResourceSpans{batch(7, "worker", "inside-final-second", 1, 0, 40*ns+500_000_000, 40*ns+900_000_000)}},
		{ResourceSpans: []*tv.ResourceSpans{batch(8, "frontend", "many-root", 1, 0, 55*ns, 56*ns), batch(8, "worker", "many-a", 2, 1, 57*ns, 58*ns), batch(8, "worker", "many-b", 3, 1, 58*ns, 59*ns), batch(8, "worker", "many-c", 4, 1, 59*ns, 60*ns)}},
	}
	var rows []*Trace
	all := &tempopb.Trace{}
	for _, tr := range inputs {
		all.ResourceSpans = append(all.ResourceSpans, tr.ResourceSpans...)
		id := tr.ResourceSpans[0].ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].TraceId
		row, _ := traceToParquet(&backend.BlockMeta{}, id, tr, nil)
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	block := makeBackendBlockWithTraces(t, rows)
	ctx := context.Background()
	opts := common.DefaultSearchOptions()
	selector := `{ resource.service.namespace = "example" && resource.service.name = "worker" && resource.deployment.environment =~ "production" } with (most_recent=true)`
	type Case struct {
		Name                    string `json:"name"`
		Query                   string `json:"query"`
		Start, End, Limit, SPSS uint32
		Response                json.RawMessage `json:"response"`
	}
	cases := []Case{{Name: "overlap-and-outside-match", Start: 30, End: 40, Limit: 100, SPSS: 3}, {Name: "most-recent-before-limit", Start: 30, End: 40, Limit: 1, SPSS: 1}, {Name: "gap-overlap", Start: 25, End: 30, Limit: 100, SPSS: 3}, {Name: "inclusive-left", Start: 50, End: 50, Limit: 100, SPSS: 3}, {Name: "no-match", Start: 80, End: 90, Limit: 100, SPSS: 3}, {Name: "final-second-exclusive", Start: 40, End: 40, Limit: 100, SPSS: 3}, {Name: "final-second-included", Start: 40, End: 41, Limit: 100, SPSS: 3}, {Name: "sample-not-matched-count", Start: 55, End: 60, Limit: 100, SPSS: 1}}
	for i := range cases {
		c := &cases[i]
		c.Query = selector
		response, err := traceql.NewEngine().ExecuteSearch(ctx, &tempopb.SearchRequest{Query: selector, Start: c.Start, End: c.End, Limit: c.Limit, SpansPerSpanSet: c.SPSS}, traceql.NewSpansetFetcherWrapper(func(ctx context.Context, req traceql.FetchSpansRequest) (traceql.FetchSpansResponse, error) {
			return block.Fetch(ctx, req, opts)
		}))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		// Provider work counters depend on physical layout, not query semantics.
		response.Metrics = nil
		for _, tr := range response.Traces {
			for _, ss := range tr.SpanSets {
				for _, sp := range ss.Spans {
					sort.Slice(sp.Attributes, func(i, j int) bool { return sp.Attributes[i].Key < sp.Attributes[j].Key })
				}
			}
		}
		buffer := proto.NewBuffer(nil)
		if err := buffer.Marshal(response); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile("/tmp/pulse-tempo-search/search-"+c.Name+".protobuf", buffer.Bytes(), 0644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		out, err := (&jsonpb.Marshaler{}).MarshalToString(response)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		c.Response = json.RawMessage(out)
		// Optional one-off consumer interoperability check, never required for replay.
		if wire, err := os.ReadFile("/tmp/pulse-tempo-search/elixir-" + c.Name + ".protobuf"); err == nil {
			var decoded tempopb.SearchResponse
			if err := proto.Unmarshal(wire, &decoded); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			got, err := (&jsonpb.Marshaler{}).MarshalToString(&decoded)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			var wantMap, gotMap interface{}
			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &wantMap); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(got), &gotMap); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			// Absent and empty repeated traces are the same protobuf default.
			if len(response.Traces) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			wantBytes, _ := json.Marshal(wantMap)
			gotBytes, _ := json.Marshal(gotMap)
			if string(wantBytes) != string(gotBytes) {
				t.Fatalf("consumer mismatch %s: got %s want %s", c.Name, gotBytes, wantBytes)
			}
		}
	}
	out, err := json.MarshalIndent(cases, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile("/tmp/pulse-tempo-search/search-oracle.json", append(out, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	wire, err := proto.Marshal(all)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile("/tmp/pulse-tempo-search/search-input.protobuf", wire, 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Log("Trace 1", hex.EncodeToString(inputs[0].ResourceSpans[0].ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].TraceId))
}
